Depending on how much accounts get in the block, a client has to load the unique 64 KiB code of these accounts, plus do the 64 KiB JUMPDEST analysis what el do you run? geth yes geht works I run that too 🙂 geth/nethermind work, all others kinda dead I don't know what that means, but you are doing a good job killing els who did you bribe to get your own label? also buildoor produced an invalid payload ``` warn: Error processing execution payload from gossip slot=172896, root=0xe881f45bbf2e2d78b1152c32563302f44c941a681c1e692b26639b861a45e874, peer=16Uiu2HAkyHBfkz4nb2tYze4X14nJ7pjhE4ZQkH4L5zoQDACJ9vZ8 - Envelope verification error: Withdrawals mismatch between payload and expected payload=0xe153a69a2db0c66820ee847ff5c1db263840310a145132f794018b7305b9dff3 expected=0xe47b0e93ac8f6b46f5c65c254abd0437e99ec8490dcbcfcb636be7ab1f79f3f2 plataberget-beacon | Error: Envelope verification error: Withdrawals mismatch between payload and expected payload=0xe153a69a2db0c66820ee847ff5c1db263840310a145132f794018b7305b9dff3 expected=0xe47b0e93ac8f6b46f5c65c254abd0437e99ec8490dcbcfcb636be7ab1f79f3f2 ``` Prysm nethermind issue is interesting. Watchtower on every devnet-8 host redeploys nethermind:master every time a new build lands (five times today), and after each restart Nethermind spends ~10 min replaying 128 blocks with the engine port closed. During that window every newPayload from prysm fails with ``` got an unexpected error in JSON-RPC response: 500 Internal Server Error: {"message":"proxy request error: Post \"http://execution:8551/\": dial tcp [2604:a880:4:1d0:0:3:486c:a00e]:8551: connect: connection refused","status":"error"}: received an undefined execution engine error ``` Prysm is slow at syncing, we should reduce wait for bandwidth a bit How does Prysm know Nethermind is online? Does it mark it as online because it could query something else (e.g. `eth`)?

excerpts.content:
Prysm nethermind issue is interesting.   Watchtower on every devnet-8 host redeploys nethermind:master every time a new build lands (five times today), and after each restart Nethermind spends ~10 min replaying 128 blocks with the engine port closed. During that window every newPayload from prysm fails with
```
got an unexpected error in JSON-RPC response: 500 Internal Server Error: {"message":"proxy request error: Post \"http://execution:8551/\": dial tcp [2604:a880:4:1d0:0:3:486c:a00e]:8551: connect: connection refused","status":"error"}: received an undefined execution engine error
```
